author: Aerosmith
body:
IGN: Aerosmith
Reason for Ban: Kill Aura
Appeal: It is true. I used kill aura during a scrim. I'm not one to lie about it, I did what I did. I ultimately regret it, simply because I ruined my reputation as well as left a great community. I'm here writing this to ask not to be unbanned today, but to be unbanned eventually. I still think I haven't completely stayed banned long enough [Two Months] and I want to finish the time. I'm sorry for being inconsiderate.

 Peace, Rock & Roll,
Josh
